title: Series B Announcement
summary: HappyRobot secures $44M in Series B funding to expand its AI operating system for logistics and industrial enterprises.
body_markdown:
We’re excited to share some big news: **HappyRobot has raised a $44 million Series B** , led by **Base10 Partners** with participation from **a16z, Array Ventures, Avra, Samsara Ventures, Tokio Marine, WaVe-X, WiL, YC, and other strategic investors** .


This milestone comes just **10 months after our $15.6M Series A** , bringing our total funding to **$62 million** .


## From First Customer to 70+ Enterprises


Just a year and a half ago, we went into production with our very first customer. Today, we’re proud to be powering operations for more than **70 enterprise customers** , including **DHL, Ryder, Schneider, and Werner** .


These companies are already seeing what’s possible when AI workers step in to take on complex, high-volume tasks:


- **Appointment scheduling** reduced from a week to under 30 minutes
- **Collections** delivering returns of more than 100x
- **Outbound sales** producing ROI north of 19x
- **Carrier sales** driving 5x returns


The early results are clear: AI workers aren’t just cutting costs — they’re unlocking new revenue opportunities, increasing visibility, and freeing teams to focus on strategic, relationship-driven work.


## Building the AI Operating System for the Real Economy


Our mission is ambitious: to build the **AI operating system for the real economy** .


The AI OS is a system that closes the circuit between intelligence and action. By combining real-time truth, specialized AI workers, and an orchestrating intelligence, HappyRobot manages complex, mission-critical work with true autonomy. Starting with supply chain and industrial-scale operations, we empower enterprises to operate with speed and continuous improvement—while humans focus on higher-value work.


This is just the beginning. Impact is exponential with an intelligence that learns & improves in real time.


## Accelerating with Series B


This new round of funding will help us accelerate towards our mission by


- Hiring world-class talent to join our team
- Continuing to advance the product and make our product even more powerful
- Expanding into more enterprise deployments


It’s fuel to scale what we’ve built so far — and to keep pushing toward the operating system that the world’s most impactful companies will run on.


## We’re Just Getting Started


We’re deeply grateful to our team, customers, partners, and investors who believe in this mission & support us in getting there.


👉 **We’re hiring.** If you want to help us build the operating system that powers the real economy,[come join us.](https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/happyrobot.ai)
